moratorium.def: A period at the start of your loan where you don't have to pay EMIs. Interest may still accrue.

amortization.def: A table showing how your loan is paid off month by month, splitting each payment into principal and interest.

npa.def: A bank loan where the borrower has stopped paying. Lower NPA means a healthier bank.

subsidy.def: Government contribution to reduce your loan burden. You don't pay back this portion.

margin_money.def: The percentage of the project cost you pay from your own pocket. The bank covers the rest.

bpl.def: Families earning below a government-defined threshold, eligible for special benefits.
